verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Be my first love
Be my first love
Light a way for my feet
And wash me in Your words of life

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Holy Spirit give me a passion
For the Son of God
Holy Spirit give me a passion
For the Son of God

verse.name: e1
verse.lines:
My heart cries Jesus, Jesus
Jesus Lord
My heart cries Jesus, Jesus
Jesus, Lord of my life

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Be my first love
Be my first love
Fill my heart with desire
For holy fire to burn within
